newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales on no slaughter steers and 100 heifers, 4,700 head confirmed for the week to date.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1025 lbs 68.00.
Confirmed - 100 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 300
Wk to Date - 4,700 Week Ago - 800 Year Ago - 11,600
